releases.title: Playtest build 1: Pong (game-developer@17c81784, artist@b2daa703)
releases.author: producer
releases.body:
Assembled delivery for the playtest: game-developer@17c817841624e764530b705e233402d9252d955a (root) + artist@b2daa7038200d3e5c5c85a5bae323c40fafb319b (assets/).

Start: unzip pong-delivery-1.zip, then open pong/index.html in Chromium, or serve pong/ with a static server (python3 -m http.server -d pong).
Controls: Enter starts from the title screen; Up/Down or W/S move your (left) paddle; first to 5 wins; Enter or click on the result screen plays again.
Judge against R1-R8 in brief.md (ht-role brief).

releases.title: Pong build 3 (clean title and result screens)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Playable Pong, assembled delivery: game `game-developer@e2970e952cdb0273617ac41c547a0d3cb3c81502` + art `artist@b2daa7038200d3e5c5c85a5bae323c40fafb319b` (`assets/`), as `ht-role delivery` assembles it.

**Change since build-2:** the dashed centre line is drawn only on the court during play and pause, so it no longer runs through the title and result-screen text (#4). No change to the rules or controls.

**Start it:** download `pong-build-3.zip` and unzip it. Then either open `pong/index.html` in a browser (works from file://, no network needed), or run `python3 -m http.server 8000` inside `pong/` and open http://localhost:8000/.

**Controls:** Enter/Space (or click) starts a match and plays again · W/S or ↑/↓ move your paddle (left) · P or Esc pauses · M mutes · Esc on the result screen returns to the title.

**Checked:** `tests/play_match.py --root <delivery> --file` in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64) on this assembled delivery: 16/16 checks pass, the same checks as build-2:
- title screen, and Enter starts a match
- keyboard moves the paddle, and the computer paddle moves on its own
- score updates one point at a time and the match ends at 5
- player can win (5–0), and the computer wins (0–5) when the player does nothing
- play again via Enter and via click resets to 0–0
- pause works
- all 5 sounds play and all 10 art files load
- no page errors, and the game starts from file://

releases.title: Pong build 1 (playable, placeholder visuals)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Build 1 of Pong, from main `b9b32f8794e6834ca7843b012ab04d587c14b42c`.

**Start:** unzip, then either open `pong/index.html` in a browser, or in `pong/` run `python3 -m http.server 8000` and open http://localhost:8000/.
**Controls:** Enter/Space (or click) start / play again · W/S or ↑/↓ move · P/Esc pause · M mute · Esc on result screen → title.

**Checked** on this revision with `python3 tests/play_match.py --file` (Playwright 1.64 Chromium headless): 14/14 checks pass: title screen, Enter starts, keyboard moves paddle, computer paddle moves, score increments one point at a time, match ends at 5, player can win (5-0), Enter on win screen restarts at 0-0, idle player loses 0-5, click restarts, pause/resume, no page errors, starts from file://. Screenshots attached.

**Not yet in:** the artist's assets (artist#2) — this build draws plain shapes with the fallback palette and is silent; it logs `asset missing: …` per absent file.
